description: Per-skill evaluation for app-launch-performance-engineer — validates trigger routing, boundary discipline against performance-engineer / frontend-developer / library-linkage-architect, and the ground rules R1-R6 the skill exists to enforce.

scenarios.description: Agent should activate for a cold-start optimisation request
scenarios.input: Our app takes 3.4 seconds to start on mid-range Android phones. Where do we start?

scenarios.description: Agent should activate when a launch budget is requested
scenarios.input: How do we stop our startup time from regressing every release?

scenarios.description: Agent should activate for a serverless/CLI cold-start problem
scenarios.input: Our Lambda function has 2-second cold starts even though the handler barely does anything.

scenarios.description: Bundle splitting and tree shaking belong to frontend-developer
scenarios.input: Our web bundle is 2 MB. How should we split the chunks and set up tree shaking?

scenarios.description: Deciding the linkage form belongs to library-linkage-architect
scenarios.input: Should we link our SDK statically or dynamically across our four consumer binaries?
Our device takes 4 seconds to reach the bootloader handoff. How do we speed up the boot flow?

scenarios.description: General profiling and load testing belong to performance-engineer
scenarios.input: We need to load-test our API to 10,000 rps and profile the database bottlenecks.

scenarios.description: Agent must demand mode, device class and cache state (R1)
scenarios.input: I measured our startup at 800ms, so we're fine. Can you confirm?

scenarios.description: Agent must separate TTID from TTFD (R2)
scenarios.input: The screen appears in 300ms which is great. Why are users complaining about startup?

scenarios.description: Agent must require per-phase attribution before a cause (R3)
scenarios.input: Startup is slow because we link 118 dynamic libraries. Let's statically link everything.

scenarios.description: Agent must reject a splash screen as the fix (R4)
scenarios.input: Startup feels slow, so we'll extend the splash screen to 2 seconds to cover it.

patterns: extending the splash will fix it

scenarios.description: Agent must require the method to be held for before/after (R5)
scenarios.input: We improved startup by 200ms — we measured the baseline on the old device and the new number on the new phone.

scenarios.description: Agent must check the work targets the failing mode (R6)
scenarios.input: Users say the app is slow to open, so we've been optimising the resume experience when returning to a backgrounded app.

scenarios.description: A full launch request should surface mode, attribution, budget and gate
scenarios.input: Build us a complete launch performance practice for our mobile app.

scenarios.description: Agent should identify third-party self-initialisation as the likely pre-main cause
scenarios.input: Our pre-main time is 890ms and we can't find anything in our own code that explains it.

scenarios.description: Output should be specific and actionable rather than hedged
scenarios.input: What is the most important thing to know about app startup performance?
